q_001.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' COLLATE NOCASE;

q_002.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_approved_amount FROM loan WHERE status = 'A';

q_003.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_count FROM disp WHERE type = 'OWNER';

q_004.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payments), 2) AS avg_monthly_payment FROM loan;

q_005.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_clients_count
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 10000;

q_006.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'Prague' COLLATE NOCASE;

q_007.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM trans
WHERE account_id = 1
  AND date >= '1997-01-01'
  AND date <= '1997-12-31';

q_008.sql:
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM disp
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND d.A3 = 'south Moravia' COLLATE NOCASE
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY owner_count DESC;

q_009.sql:
SELECT d.client_id, c.gender, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

q_010.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = account.account_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id AND client.gender = 'M'
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id AND district.A3 = 'north Bohemia' COLLATE NOCASE
WHERE loan.status = 'C';
